children: Polymarket’s submarket for the CBLOL playoff match between LOS and FURIA Esports saw the “LOS” option in the “Game 3 Winner” market jump from 54.5% one hour ago to 95%, according to Catcher Predict. According to ChainCatcher, the move represents a 40.5% swing and may reflect the impact of breaking news.

title: LOS Game 3 Winner Odds Surge to 95% in Polymarket CBLOL Playoff Match
